about_text: Typlet {version} is free and open source. If it saves you time, you can support its development.
app_rules_help: Change how Typlet behaves in single programs, identified by their file name (for example program.exe). Built-in rules already cover {apps}. App rules work on Windows; GNOME does not tell Typlet which app is active.
check_for_updates: Look for a new version once a day
check_for_updates_hint: Typlet only asks GitHub for the newest version. Your snippets never leave your computer.
chip_clipboard_title: Inserts what is on the clipboard at that moment
chip_cursor_title: The text cursor ends up here
chip_field_missing: This field does not exist; choose another one
chip_snippet_missing_title: This snippet no longer exists; choose another one or remove it
chip_snippet_title: Replaced by the snippet {trigger} when inserting
conflict_in_list: This trigger collides with another one
date_offset_help: For example 1 for tomorrow or -1 for yesterday.
delete_confirm_used: Delete “{label}”? It is used in {users} and will be missing there. This cannot be undone.
discard_changes: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
editor_placeholder: Type the text Typlet should insert…
enabled_title: Inactive snippets are kept but never inserted
field_remove_used: Also removes the field from the text
form_fields_help: Typlet asks these questions before inserting the snippet.
home_count: You have {count} snippets. Choose one on the left or create a new one.
home_donate: Typlet is free. Does it save you time?
home_empty: You have no snippets yet. Create your first one or import them from espanso.
home_stats: So far Typlet has inserted {count} snippets for you and saved about {time} of typing.
hotkey_invalid: Use Ctrl, Alt or Win together with a key, or a function key.
import_intro: Typlet can take over your snippets from espanso. Your espanso files stay unchanged; the imported snippets appear in the category “espanso”.
import_not_found: No espanso folder found. Choose it by hand if espanso is installed elsewhere.
insert_clipboard_title: Insert the clipboard content at this point
insert_cursor_title: Place the text cursor here after inserting
insert_cursor_used: The snippet already has a cursor position
insert_date_title: Insert today's date (click the date to change its format)
insert_field_title: Ask a question before inserting and put the answer here
insert_snippet_title: Insert another snippet here. When you change it, it changes everywhere it is used.
library_errors: Files that could not be loaded
library_help: Each snippet is a small file in this folder. Choose a synced folder (for example OneDrive) to use your snippets on several computers.
name: Name
notifications: Show a message when inserting fails
preview_empty: The preview appears as soon as the snippet has text.
save_invalid: The snippet cannot be saved yet: {problem}
settings_saved: Settings saved. Typlet applies them right away.
settings_unreadable: The settings file could not be read ({problem}). Saving the settings replaces it.
skip_missing_match: Inserts another match that could not be imported
skip_unsupported_variable: Uses a variable Typlet does not support
snippet_hotkey_help: Inserts this snippet without typing the trigger.
snippet_include_help: Its form questions are asked together with this snippet's.
snippet_picker_more: {count} more – type to narrow them down
snippet_picker_none: There are no other snippets yet that could be inserted here.
start_with_system: Start Typlet when the computer starts
statistics_setting: Count inserted snippets for the statistics (numbers only, never text)
stats_empty: Nothing counted yet. Type a trigger anywhere, and Typlet shows here how much typing you save.
stats_privacy: Typlet keeps only numbers, on this computer, never what you type.
stats_privacy_since: Counted since {since}. Typlet keeps only numbers, on this computer, never what you type.
stats_reset_confirm: Delete all statistics and milestones? This cannot be undone.
stats_time_hint: Estimated at 200 characters per minute, an average typing speed
stats_turn_on: Switch it on in the settings
tip_placeholders: Insert today's date, the clipboard, a small form or another snippet with the buttons above the text.
tip_search: Forgot a trigger? Press Ctrl+Shift+Space anywhere to search.
tip_trigger: Start triggers with a character like : so they never fire inside normal words.
trigger_duplicate: “{other}” already uses this trigger. Only one of them will work.
trigger_empty: Choose what you will type, for example :hello.
trigger_shadowed_by: This trigger can never be completed: {other} is replaced first.
trigger_shadows: This trigger stops {other} from working, because it is replaced first.
trigger_symbols_only: Add at least one letter or digit, otherwise the trigger fires all the time.
trigger_tip: Type the trigger anywhere and Typlet replaces it with the text below.
trigger_too_long: A trigger can have at most 64 characters.
update_failed: Looking for updates did not work ({problem}). Check your internet connection and try again.
update_manual: This copy of Typlet cannot update itself. Download the new version from the download page.
update_restart_note: Typlet restarts afterwards. Your snippets and settings stay as they are.
update_restarting: Installing. Typlet restarts in a moment…
warn_offset_rounded: date shift rounded to whole days
warn_word_boundary: expands instantly (espanso waited for a word end)
